title: Xiangqi, Free Play, two moves: the same round trip on the 9x10 board
why: The whole session round trip under the other game. It pins that a session replays, commits, resumes and encodes under the game its configuration froze rather than under one the core assumes: a core that carried a single starting position or a single ruleset would produce the wrong board here and pass every Mini Xiangqi scenario unchanged.
